text:
B: Hi, can you hear me?
A: Yeah. Alright. Darren.
B: Jasmine. Where are you?
A: Maidstone. You?
B: Plymouth.
A: Long way.
B: Everyone says that. What do you do?
A: Bins. Loader on the council rounds.
B: Oh, okay. I've got two bubble tea shops, and honestly, our bins are a nightmare. Commercial waste is so expensive. I had to haggle the contract down last year, they wanted to put it up like fifteen percent.
A: Did you get it down?
B: To about six. I said I'd go somewhere else. I wouldn't have, but they didn't know that.
A: Fair play.
B: Is it the same for you, the commercial ones?
A: Nah, I'm domestic. Houses. Six o'clock start, same rounds eleven years.
B: Eleven years, wow. You must know every house.
A: I know which ones put rubbish in the recycling. That's most of them.
B: My staff do that. The cups with the plastic seal on top, they just chuck them in with the cardboard. I keep telling them.
A: That's exactly it. Then the whole bin gets rejected and they ring up and say we never took it. Half the time I'll stand there and pick the bits out myself so the whole street doesn't get marked down, and nobody thanks you for that, mate.
B: No, nobody thanks you. Same with running a shop, to be fair. Saturdays, someone always calls in sick. Every Saturday.
A: Never missed a start, me.
B: Seriously? In eleven years?
A: Not once.
B: Can I hire you?
A: Ha. Don't think I'd be any good at bubble tea.
B: You'd be fine. It's just pressing buttons, honestly. My partner Tom's like you, though. Just gets on with it. He's a marine engineer at Devonport.
A: Sensible bloke.
B: He is. Do you have family?
A: Partner, Tracey. And the dog, Roxy. Staffie. She's getting on now. Bad hips.
B: Oh no. Vet bills?
A: Don't. Every month something.
B: We've got a cat, Biscuit. She's fine, she just knocks everything off the counter. Do you go on holiday much?
A: Caravan in Norfolk. Benidorm every couple of years 'cause Tracey likes it. I can't stand airports.
B: I don't mind airports if I can sit in the lounge. I fly home to Malaysia via Doha, it's a long one. But I like Tenerife, all-inclusive, pool, done.
A: Yeah, see, that's what Tracey would want.
B: She's right, lah. You don't have to do anything.
A: Except queue for two hours at Gatwick.
B: Bristol's quicker, for me anyway. Or Exeter.
A: I'll mention it. She won't listen, mind.
